notes: ODL-947 follow-up (t_370d2664): the access report is checked against a number this boot can have. The installer re-embeds installer/access_report.sh (7c5629c2…, 5,322 bytes): the wrapper passes the image pin as --expect only when this boot's own report agrees with it, and otherwise passes the boot's own measurement and names both numbers on one line — a pin is a file's measurement (an empty command line and the builder's vCPU count), while a tenant's boot line is per machine, so the seal row failed at every boot of an image that had its pin and odile-access-report never started (odile-release-setup.sh logs the same disagreement for the installer). This cut is 2026.11.25-1 over main's 2026.11.23-9 (the ODL-947 follow-up on the seeded first boot: install-stack.sh's production branch writes the seed's verifier when the .env does not hold it and stamps only after the write, and installer.ensure_env does the same on a run that finds a placeholder and keeps a hash the owner's own visit recorded), which carries 2026.11.23-8 (ODL-926's one-code cut). Against -9 only installer_sha256, the manifest and this document's hashes move; no skill, page or template changed. This cut is 2026.11.25-2, re-cut over 2026.11.25-1 (the ODL-947 follow-up's access-report rule) on main's 2026.11.23-9, and carries t_937310bf: the machine's own /verify page no longer runs the handoff audit on every request — under --serve one audit answer is kept for --audit-ttl seconds (20), a stale answer is served at once while one background thread reads a new one, a failed answer is never kept, and the page names the answer it shows ('audit as of <UTC>') whenever an earlier request read it; the rows, the verdicts and the per-row provenance are unchanged, and --json/--out never use the cache. The first visit's done page names the action that path completed: a seeded login says 'You are signed in.' and a classic setup keeps 'Your sign-in is set.', with the code, the one-time download and the state write unchanged. The installer re-embeds verify/verify.py (a1ac889e…, 57,492 bytes), installer/first_visit.py (5dd8c97a…, 87,140 bytes) and web/first-visit.html (d69f6abb…, 47,046 bytes) over 2026.11.25-1's access_report.sh (7c5629c2…, 5,322 bytes); templates/verify.html (1f5314db…) is unchanged. The manifest's diff against 2026.11.25-1 is installer_sha256 alone (audit 6d3f7be0…, backup d9c4278a…, the 48 skill rows and skills.tar.gz 9a10a63e… unchanged).
